projects.name: Lotus Infrastructure Partners natural gas facilities acquisition
projects.quote: Executed definitive agreement to acquire seven natural gas facilities, • totaling ~2,600 MW of capacity, from Lotus Infrastructure Partners, which will further geographically diversify our natural gas fleet.

projects.name: Texas (ERCOT) solar facility power purchase agreement with Amazon
projects.quote: Progressing with construction in support of two power purchase agreements at new solar facilities, together • totaling over 600 MW, with two of the world’s leading technology companies – 200 MW with Amazon in Texas (ERCOT) and 405 MW with Microsoft in Illinois (MISO).
